origine_fr: La butte 阝 et 且, qui donnait le son mais se lit qiě, plus zǔ. Le premier sens est « passage escarpé ». Le relief qui barre la route : empêcher, bloquer.
origine_en: A mound 阝 plus 且, which gave the sound but is read qiě, not zǔ. It first meant “a steep pass”. Terrain that bars the road: to block, to hinder.
